global.titulo: Pablo Cansinos — Consulting, Strategy & Project Management
tema.conmutar: Switch between light and dark theme
inicio.propuesta: Business profile based in Madrid, with experience in diagnosis, process analysis, project management and international settings. I connect business needs with practical solutions supported by data, technology and AI.
perfil.parrafo1: From business analysis to decision-making: understanding how an organization works, structuring its challenges and turning information into recommendations on what to improve.
perfil.parrafo2: I currently work at AiKit Research (Madrid) as a Strategy Consultant & AI: I lead diagnostic sessions with companies, analyze their processes and operational pain points, and translate those needs into actionable recommendations supported by artificial intelligence, automation, ERP and digital tools. Direct contact with decision-makers —founders and business leaders— gives me a cross-functional view of the operational, commercial and organizational challenges across a range of sectors.
perfil.parrafo3: Before that, at Expedia Group, in Prague, I managed a portfolio of 180+ hotel partners, using performance, revenue, pricing and digital-positioning data to spot opportunities and recommend actions. At ESIC University I coordinated international programs, European-funded projects and institutions from different countries.
perfil.parrafo4: I'm excited by roles related to strategy, transformation, business analysis, operations and projects: settings where a business problem can be structured into practical solutions supported by technology and data.
areas.consultoria.texto: Diagnosing a company’s situation and recommending what actions to take.
areas.procesos.texto: Analyzing workflows, identifying frictions and proposing operational-efficiency improvements.
areas.proyectos.texto: Coordinating stakeholders, deliverables and dependencies across projects with multiple parties involved.
areas.datos.texto: Analyzing data to answer business questions.
trayectoria.aikit.contexto: AiKit Research is a pioneering artificial-intelligence lab in Spain. A startup focused today on an AI product geared toward business automation through the creation of its own agents.
trayectoria.aikit.contribucion: As a Strategy Consultant & AI, I support companies in adopting artificial intelligence: from identifying the use case to defining prioritized, actionable roadmaps. I lead diagnostic sessions with client teams to turn operational frictions into concrete use cases, success metrics and implementation plans, which I capture in tailored diagnostic reports with prioritized, ready-to-execute recommendations. Direct work with founders and business leaders brings a cross-functional view of each company's operational, commercial and organizational challenges.
trayectoria.aikit.evidencia: 60+ companies advised and €800,000+ in consulting revenue generated through strategic advisory, in regular contact with C-level profiles at SMEs.
trayectoria.expedia.cargo: Partner Success Associate — Business Performance & Partner Advisory
trayectoria.expedia.contribucion: I managed a portfolio of 180+ hotel partners, analyzing their performance on the platform —revenue, pricing, visibility, campaigns and digital positioning— to spot opportunities and recommend concrete actions.
trayectoria.expedia.contribucion2: I also advised partners on market trends, demand patterns and digital distribution, working with cross-functional teams to align improvements with the property's and the platform's objectives.
trayectoria.expedia.evidencia: 180+ hotel partners managed through performance analysis, data-driven advisory and recommendations tailored to each partner.
trayectoria.esic.contexto: At ESIC University I managed international programs and projects with partner institutions across five continents, working regularly in English and coordinating multiple internal and external stakeholders.
trayectoria.esic.contribucion: I coordinated international programs, Erasmus+ Blended Intensive Programs, inter-institutional agreements, European funds and events such as International Weeks and private programs. I also represented ESIC at meetings organized by the European Commission and coordinated the mobility of international students and staff between institutions.
trayectoria.esic.contribucion2: This experience strengthened my ability to structure projects, coordinate counterparts from different countries, manage European documentation and funding, and ensure the follow-up of programs with multiple parties involved.
trayectoria.esic.evidencia: 700+ international students a year, 80+ staff mobilities and €130,000 in grants managed.
trayectoria.orange.contribucion: I supported the shift toward an omnichannel sales model through channel analysis, reporting and coordination across sales management, distributors and partner outlets.
trayectoria.orange.contribucion2: I also built Excel databases to streamline CRM testing and process management for SMEs and public-sector clients.
trayectoria.gmp.texto: I analyzed multichannel data and designed actions aimed at improving user experience and engagement. I coordinated communications, events and webinars, strengthened stakeholder relationships and developed promotional campaigns that contributed to 27% growth in the user base over two months.
trayectoria.payflow.texto: I helped build the customer service and operations functions from scratch under the direct supervision of the vice-president, developing workflows tailored to a startup environment.
trayectoria.payflow.texto2: I designed a semi-automated WhatsApp acquisition and communication process that improved the process's performance by more than 170% and raised app adoption from 18% to 27%.
proyectos.intro: Almas Inquietas is a grassroots collective that turns sport into initiatives with social impact. We organize charity tournaments and challenges, mobilize communities and sponsors, and direct the funds raised to specific causes through social organizations. I take part as an associate member in organizing and coordinating its projects.
proyectos.futbol.texto: Charity tournament organized by Almas Inquietas in support of Ideorama, an association that works with children and families in areas such as education, responsible use of technology and healthy leisure. I took part in organizing and coordinating a day that brought together sport, community, social organizations and sponsors.
proyectos.futbol.foto1.alt: Attendees gathered by an Almas Inquietas stand at the charity football tournament.
proyectos.futbol.foto2.alt: The tournament team wearing medals next to the Ideorama banner.
proyectos.futbol.patrocinadores: Supported by Día, Telepizza, Pozuelo Town Council and other sponsors.
proyectos.padel.texto: The Mindful Padel was the collective’s second tournament. Played in pairs at Club de Pádel Bularas, in Pozuelo de Alarcón, it directed the funds raised to Fundación Blas Méndez Ponce, which supports children with cancer and hard-to-treat illnesses.
proyectos.padel.texto2: I took part in organizing the event, coordinating with collaborators and communicating the initiative.
proyectos.padel.foto1.alt: Poster for the ‘The Mindful Padel’ charity tournament.
proyectos.padel.foto2.alt: Sponsor MG Albión Motor’s car on display at the tournament.
proyectos.padel.patrocinadores: Supported by MG Albión Motor, Padel Bularas, Minigymrats, Cañas y Tapas, Día, Herbalife and other sponsors.
proyectos.rtw.texto: Ride the Wave is the most ambitious challenge Almas Inquietas has taken on so far. Alex, co-founder of the collective, is cycling the distance between Prague and Madrid: nine countries and roughly 4,000 kilometres.
proyectos.rtw.contribucion: The project mobilizes a community on Strava under the idea ‘one kilometre, one euro’, with the goal of raising €4,000 for Fundación Verón’s school-meals program, which supports the education and nutrition of children in Honduras.
proyectos.rtw.contribucion2: The initiative combines sport, social impact and digital tools: a kilometre counter connected to Strava, a website to follow the route stage by stage and a crowdfunding campaign supported by Fundación Verón.
proyectos.rtw.foto1.alt: Ride the Wave jersey showing the Fundación Verón logos.
proyectos.rtw.foto2.alt: Touring bike loaded for the trip, camped at sunset.
trayectoria.n2growth.texto: I supported the director in executive search projects through market and company research, candidate mapping and building structured databases.
trayectoria.n2growth.texto2: I also contributed to identifying business opportunities and preparing presentations and materials for clients.
